question: Should OpenClaw core own durable local marketplace watches and accept the shared-state v4 migration for this first notification slice?
rationale: This is a new persistent product capability with a shared database-version change; repository policy requires explicit acceptance before that schema boundary advances.

options.title: Sponsor the core design
options.body: Accept the core-owned watch and update-history model, then require upgrade and real-behavior proof before merge.

options.title: Redirect the capability
options.body: Keep core limited to feed refresh and catalog seams, and move local watch behavior to an external plugin or other approved extension surface.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the core design
recommendation.body: Accept the core-owned watch and update-history model, then require upgrade and real-behavior proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: Current-main ownership could not be attributed from the supplied review context, so the relevant marketplace and shared-state owner should make the product decision.
